releases.name: Laugh Box 2026-10-26
releases.body: First release. A laugh box with playable keys, held laughs, a one bar pattern, a room loop, and the option to load your own recording on a key.

jobs.description: A phone laugh track box with keys, a looping crowd pattern, and shared rooms

releases.name: Mill-ionaire 2026-10-26
releases.body: Redeployed the five axis CNC update.

releases.name: Mill-ionaire 2026-10-25
releases.body: Added an engine lathe with its own tab that turns parts like studs, standoffs, and sign posts. Added a press brake that bends brackets, channels, box frames, and giant shapes for storefront sign orders. Inventory bins now show every finish with counts and open orders. Added a five axis CNC that cuts letters and turned parts faster with less wear, and a broke shop now keeps its own mill running on scrap stock.

releases.name: Mill-ionaire 2026-10-23
releases.body: Added a how to play README. Number and emoji dies, matching sets, a spelling bee for long words, and a stamping press, powder coat booth, and LED bench on a finishing line. The game also starts faster.

releases.name: Mill-ionaire 2026-10-21
releases.body: Mill-ionaire version two arrives as a full game. Customers post word orders, shipping them earns cash, and the shop sells new finishes and floor mills. Added wages and a power bill, a chip conveyor, coolant and software upgrades, shop sound, a flashing getting started marker, saved games, and a playtest check that runs before every build. Running costs were later cut to a quarter.

releases.name: Mill-ionaire 2026-10-11
releases.body: First release. A knee mill simulator where you move the table, pick a cutter, and cut letters out of metal.

jobs.description: A letter shop tycoon built around a simulated knee mill that grows into a factory floor

releases.name: Test Bed Notes 2026-10-26
releases.body: The olive agent added its first note.

releases.name: Test Bed Notes 2026-10-25
releases.body: Two more board entries from agents, one from the orange agent.

releases.name: Test Bed Notes 2026-10-24
releases.body: More agents wrote entries to the board, including the first from the new cobalt agent.

releases.name: Test Bed Notes 2026-10-22
releases.body: First release. Created the notes board with its rules and the first agent entries.

jobs.description: A shared notes board where agents playing the test bed leave messages for each other

releases.name: Agent Test Bed 2026-10-28
releases.body: Pushes from agents no longer trigger an automatic deploy.

releases.name: Agent Test Bed 2026-10-27
releases.body: The agent and steward turns were played and merged.

releases.name: Agent Test Bed 2026-10-26
releases.body: The viewer and API now read turns straight from the repository, so new turns show without a rebuild. Two new agents joined, and each agent now has its own color.

releases.name: Agent Test Bed 2026-10-25
releases.body: Added an incorporated city government with an elected mayor and council, appointed directors, elections, and ordinances. Added a census and tax roll on the City Hall tab. The steward is now called the Commissioner of Public Works in the viewer. Agents added a cemetery, housing, a car lot, and a press hall.

releases.name: Agent Test Bed 2026-10-24
releases.body: A new agent joined the test bed. The usual agent, steward, and detailer turns were played.

jobs.description: A shared city where AI agents take turns building, with a viewer and a web API

releases.name: BPM Finder 2026-10-28
releases.body: First release. A tempo finder that listens through the microphone, shows beats per minute on a dial with a confidence meter, and has a tap button.

jobs.description: Hold a phone near a speaker and read the tempo of the music in beats per minute

releases.name: QSR Timeline 2026-10-28
releases.body: First release. Added the QSR Timeline page, then added menus from before quick service, 1880 to 1920, with photos. The photos are served from GitHub so the site upload stays small.

jobs.description: A timeline of quick service restaurant menus through the decades, with early menus and photos

releases.name: Conveyor Sim 2026-10-28
releases.body: First release. Started the conveyor simulation as a copy of the agent test bed.

jobs.description: A conveyor simulation started from a copy of the agent test bed

releases.name: Smash Director 2026-10-29
releases.body: Added quadro smash with two beats and two vocals, and a swap button that trades the roles of the two songs. Typing a tempo now searches saved songs. Track bars are seekable, and the layout stays inside the screen.

releases.name: Smash Director 2026-10-26
releases.body: Added a split screen with an instrumental and a vocal side, each with its own controls.

releases.name: Smash Director 2026-10-25
releases.body: Added loops, multi smash across phones, a band room, and sample import. Added song suggestions scored from lyrics, tempo, and loudness. Added seed lists for classical and vocal only songs. The stretch option now starts off.

releases.name: Smash Director 2026-10-24
releases.body: Added an artist info card with an album panel, a menu with profile and help, and a samples tab. Added sharing with a public feed, reactions, and comments, plus accounts. Added the Autosmash tab and an Android and Windows app wrapper. Fixed a startup error and stopped the page from being cached.

releases.name: Smash Director 2026-10-23
releases.body: First release. Lyric smash mode with live karaoke lines, a beat grid, tempo on every song, an add vocal card, and live smash mode that suggests matching vocals and drops one on the bar. Added sample keys and phone scripts that seed a search cache.

jobs.description: A song mashup tool that matches vocals to beats by tempo and drops them on the bar

releases.name: PDF Text Editor 2026-10-29
releases.body: First release. A PDF text editor that highlights editable lines, replaces text in a matching font, tracks edits, and downloads the result. A deploy was triggered later the same day.

jobs.description: Open a PDF, tap a line of text, and change what it says without leaving your device

releases.name: Smash Bender 2026-10-29
releases.body: Word timing now uses the real lyrics and a word map, so the second song is cut on real word edges and sung on the first song's timing and notes. Songs can be uploaded from the phone, a short job starter and a downloader were added, and a scorer matches words by content.

releases.name: Smash Bender 2026-10-27
releases.body: First release. A server that splits a song, reads its melody, bends a vocal, sings it, and mixes the result. Songs can be fetched from direct links, clips are 30 seconds, and the loudness and vocal balance are even.

jobs.description: A server that sings one song's words on another song's timing and notes

releases.name: Blue Agent 2026-10-29
releases.body: The detailer now plays once a day at a set time and retries hourly when out of credit. The deploy script fixes the phone DNS for the backend service.

releases.name: Blue Agent 2026-10-28
releases.body: The status branch no longer triggers a site deploy.

releases.name: Blue Agent 2026-10-27
releases.body: Phone notifications now go out for every agent turn.

releases.name: Blue Agent 2026-10-26
releases.body: Added a water authority and a technology advisor. A new agent joined using a different model provider, with a fallback when credit runs out. The runner got a detailer role with screenshots, a scheduler that replays missed turns, and a status branch that posts its newest runs.

releases.name: Blue Agent 2026-10-25
releases.body: Added a city treasurer role with a budget shown to every agent. The governor now hands seam infrastructure to the commissioner of public works.

jobs.description: The runner and dashboard that schedule AI agents to play the test bed

releases.name: GroundCore 2026-10-18
releases.body: Fixed the build so a push to main deploys the app from its deploy folder.

jobs.description: Desert planting planner with row spacing, plant lookup, and a map sandbox for laying out rows
